severance.title: Severance & Notice Pay
severance.intro: Wondering what you'd get if you left your job? Enter your start date and gross salary and we'll estimate your legal entitlements.
severance.grossFromSalary: Pre-filled from your salary rule — change if needed.
severance.vacationHelp: How many unused vacation days do you have? Leave empty if unsure.
severance.serviceLine: You've worked here for {{years}} years, {{months}} months and {{days}} days.
severance.notEligible: Severance requires one full year of service (you'll qualify once you pass 1 year). The notice period still applies.
severance.heroNote: This total applies if your employer dismisses you (without just cause). If you resign, severance and notice pay are usually not paid; accrued vacation is always paid.
severance.sevExplain: 30 days of gross salary for every full year worked; partial years count proportionally.
severance.ceilingApplied: Your salary is above the legal ceiling ({{ceiling}}/mo) — by law the calculation is capped at this amount for everyone.
severance.noticeExplain: Paid if you're dismissed without prior notice: {{weeks}} weeks of pay.
severance.vacationExplain: Pay for your {{days}} unused vacation days — paid in every scenario.
severance.taxNote: Notice and vacation amounts are gross; income tax will reduce them somewhat.
severance.disclaimer: This is an estimate; regular benefits (meal/transport) are not included. Check with HR for the exact figure.
severance.emptyHint: Enter your start date and gross salary to see the estimate.
severance.computeError: Couldn't calculate. Check the date and values, then try again.
